task.property_text: Flask adds Vary: Cookie whenever the session is accessed, so a caching proxy cannot serve one client's session cookie to another.

property_clause.property: Flask adds Vary: Cookie whenever the session is accessed, so a caching proxy cannot serve one client's session cookie to another.

environment.scope: The pallets/flask library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.establish() -> str prepares the verifier's Flask app from the code under test and returns a string the caller may pass to a later call. sbc_world.request(path: str = '/resource', cookie: str | None = None, cache_control: str | None = None) performs one request against that app. The verifier applies an RFC 9111 shared-cache model to the real response headers and records a leak only when one client's Set-Cookie would be served to another client. A test that shows the failure composes establish() and request().
